name: lumantic
description: Landing page for Lumantic, an AI-native data team for growth-stage companies.

scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:generate && wrangler d1 execute lumantic-db --local --file=./scripts/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute lumantic-db --local --file=./scripts/seed-global-chats.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:seed:generate && wrangler d1 execute lumantic-db --remote --file=./scripts/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute lumantic-db --remote --file=./scripts/seed-global-chats.sql
scripts.test:e2e:relevant: playwright test e2e/app-smoke.spec.ts e2e/chat-tooltips.spec.ts e2e/reply-usage.spec.ts e2e/settings-access.spec.ts e2e/chat-pagination.spec.ts e2e/chat-charts.spec.ts
